caption: The drawing is composed of two line illustrations of a garment, specifically a loose-fitting dress or nightgown, rendered in thin, precise pencil or pen lines on a light beige background. The larger illustration, positioned slightly to the left and dominating most of the image, shows the front view of the dress, which has short sleeves, a flared shape, and decorative detailing along the wide, round neckline and at the center front. Delicate lines suggest gathers or pleats below the neckline. The smaller illustration, located in the upper right portion of the image, depicts the same dress from the back, lacking the front detailing but maintaining the general shape and neckline. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, utilizing only shades of gray on the beige paper. There is a small inscription in the lower left corner.
title: Chemise
